name: Healthy Hair, Skin & Nails Blend
storage: Store at 2-8 °C, protected from light; do not freeze.
definition: Healthy Hair, Skin & Nails Blend (HHB) is a ready-to-use liquid blend supplied as sterile solution. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 10 ml. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99% (HPLC) with sterile solution appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: What documentation is supplied with Healthy Hair, Skin & Nails Blend?
faq.answer: Every batch of Healthy Hair, Skin & Nails Blend is released against a lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA) that records the product identity, grade, appearance and the batch number. The COA for the lot you receive is available on request.

faq.question: How should Healthy Hair, Skin & Nails Blend be stored?
faq.answer: Store the HHB solution at 2–8 °C, protected from light, and do not freeze. Handling notes for each lot are printed on the certificate of analysis.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Healthy Hair, Skin & Nails Blend?
faq.answer: Healthy Hair, Skin & Nails Blend is stocked in 1 pack size (10 mL), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $104.00; 10–49 kits falls to $95.68 (−8%) and 50+ to $88.40 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
